apex-v300-dome.name: Apex V-300 Dome
apex-v300-dome.description: The Apex V-300 delivers flawless detail in difficult lighting. Built for professional installation: a reinforced housing and advanced AI motion analytics.

hik-ds-2cd2043g2-i.name: Hikvision 4MP Bullet with AcuSense
hik-ds-2cd2043g2-i.description: A bullet IP camera with AcuSense: it filters out false alarms from animals and foliage, leaving only events involving people and vehicles.
features: EXIR 2.0 infrared illumination up to 40 m

dah-ipc-hfw2431s.name: Dahua 4MP Lite IR bullet camera
dah-ipc-hfw2431s.description: A compact Lite series camera for sites where the balance of price and quality matters. H.265+ support noticeably saves space on the recorder.
features: H.265+ codec — up to 70% less storage
Power and data over a single PoE cable

hik-ds-7608ni-k2-8p.name: Hikvision 8-channel 4K NVR with 8 PoE
hik-ds-7608ni-k2-8p.description: An eight-channel recorder with a built-in PoE switch: cameras connect directly, with no separate power supply or external switch.
features: Two HDD bays, up to 10 TB each
Archive playback from the mobile app

spector-nvr-16.name: Spector NVR-1600, 16 channels
spector-nvr-16.description: A recorder for medium and large sites. RAID 1/5 and hot-swap drives keep the archive intact even if one disk fails.

poe-switch-8.name: Spector SW-8P, 8-port PoE switch
poe-switch-8.description: An unmanaged PoE switch for eight IP cameras. Extend mode stretches a run to 250 metres over ordinary twisted pair.
features: Extend mode — up to 250 m per run
6 kV surge protection on every port

turnstile-tripod.name: Spector T-200 tripod turnstile
turnstile-tripod.description: A stainless steel tripod turnstile for office and industrial checkpoints. Integrates with any access control system over dry contacts.
features: Anti-panic: arms drop on a fire alarm

barrier-4m.name: Spector B-4000 barrier with a 4 m boom
barrier-4m.description: An automatic barrier with a 4-metre boom and a 1.5-second rise time. Works with licence plate recognition out of the box.

avangard.title: Access control for a business centre
avangard.description: Installation of 12 turnstiles and integration with a time-tracking system.

warehouse.title: IP video surveillance for a warehouse
warehouse.description: Installation of 64 high-resolution cameras with licence plate recognition analytics.

perimeter.title: Perimeter security
perimeter.description: Complete perimeter protection: barriers, thermal cameras and lighting.

datacenter.title: Project Alpha: sector 7 core
datacenter.description: Full perimeter video surveillance and biometric access control for a Tier 4 data centre. Overall site security improved by 45% while staff passage got faster.

corporate.title: Global Finance headquarters integration
corporate.description: Optical turnstiles paired with RFID tracking for the company's head office. Unauthorised passage attempts dropped to zero without compromising the interior design.

logistics.title: Nexus Hub automated surveillance
logistics.description: A dense camera network with AI analytics across a 46,000 m² logistics centre. Real-time threat detection and asset tracking cut product losses noticeably.

retail-chain.title: A single standard for the Northline chain
retail-chain.description: One surveillance standard rolled out across 34 stores with centralised archive storage and shared analytics. Losses fell by a third in the first quarter.

campus.title: Westgate campus access programme
campus.description: Cards and mobile passes across eleven campus buildings, tied to the existing student directory. Granting and revoking access takes seconds instead of days.

industrial-perimeter.title: Kestrel plant perimeter protection
industrial-perimeter.description: Thermal cameras, automatic barriers and adaptive lighting along a 2.4 km industrial perimeter. Night alarms became reliable enough to cut security to a single shift.

shipping.question: Delivery times
shipping.answer: Equipment in stock ships the same working day and reaches most cities within 48 hours. Made-to-order turnstiles and barriers take 10–15 working days to produce.

returns.question: Returns and warranty
returns.answer: All equipment carries a 36-month manufacturer warranty. Unopened items can be returned within 14 days of delivery; if the fault is ours, we cover return shipping.

calibration.question: Equipment setup
calibration.answer: Cameras leave the warehouse already configured for the resolution and frame rate in your order. On-site setup guides for every series are available in your account.

installation.question: Installation and commissioning
installation.answer: Our engineers handle installation, cabling and commissioning across Kazakhstan. Site visits are free for projects of 16 cameras or more.
